head: Daybreak exports Apple Health data to CSV and JSON files
dek: Daybreak is a new $0.99 iPhone and iPad app that copies up to 80 daily Apple Health metrics into CSV and JSON files in a folder you pick. It was #80 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 18 November.
details: Metrics come in eight groups: fitness, nutrition, sleep, body measurements, heart and vitals, mindfulness, mobility and alcohol. It reads Health data only, never changes it and leaves out GPS routes; files can go on the device or in iCloud Drive. You can sync by hand, with a reminder or with a Shortcuts action. It's a one-time purchase with no account, ads or analytics, made by 137 Ventures Ltd, and needs iOS 26 or later.
where: iPhone and iPad, iOS 26 or later, $0.99 once (US price)
means: If you want your own copy of your Apple Health history to open in a spreadsheet or keep as a backup, this does it without a subscription.
todo: Pick only the Health categories you want to export when the app asks for access; if you share one export folder across devices, update all of them first.
